NOT FOUND.

What I searched
- Queried the indexed corpus "docs" for phrases like:
  - "overall materiality 2023 audit report"
  - "overall materiality \"audit report\" 2023 \"overall materiality\""
  - variations including "overall materiality 2023" and "audit report materiality"
- Listed corpora (ow_corpora) and then ran ow_query over corpus "docs".

Why I could not find it
- The most relevant file, audit-report-2023.pdf, is present but encrypted and could not be read. Omniweave reported:
  c:/users/user/appdata/local/temp/claude/.../project/docs/audit/audit-report-2023.pdf: refused as encrypted, so no document was written (needs a password to open).

Because the audit report PDF cannot be opened, I cannot read the page that would state the overall materiality. To proceed I would need an unlocked version or the password for audit-report-2023.pdf.
